# Zomboid Seasons

> Seasonal Project Zomboid survival server with Ethereum payment integration.

Zomboid Seasons runs 90-day competitive survival seasons on a dedicated Project Zomboid (Build 42) server. Players register and pay a small ETH fee to get whitelisted. Each season resets the world. Top zombie killers earn free registration for the next season — everyone else must re-register and pay.

## How it works
- Register with your Steam ID and Zomboid username
- Pay the registration fee in ETH (or use a promo code)
- Get whitelisted immediately upon payment confirmation
- Survive for 90 days — compete on the zombie kill leaderboard
- Top zombie killers earn recognition at season end
- Supply drops appear at random POIs for active players to claim

## Pages
- [Home](https://zomboid.princeofcrypto.com/): Registration, season info, supply drops
- [Leaderboard](https://zomboid.princeofcrypto.com/leaderboard.html): Zombie kill rankings
- [Systems](https://zomboid.princeofcrypto.com/systems.html): Server rules and game systems
- [Status](https://zomboid.princeofcrypto.com/status.html): Server status and incidents

## API
- GET /api/season — Current season info (id, status, dates, player count, fee)
- GET /api/seasons — All seasons history
- GET /api/leaderboard — Zombie kill leaderboard
- GET /api/supply-drops — Active supply drops
- GET /api/supply-drops/pois — Points of interest for supply drops
- GET /api/status — Server component status and incidents
- GET /api/gametime — Current in-game time
- POST /api/register — Register for the current season
- GET /api/register/{id} — Check registration status
- GET /api/saves/{season_id} — Download archived season save
